stance: These figures were measured on a single developer machine against one PostgreSQL container. They are evidence that a query plan is sound and that no scenario regressed; they are not a capacity plan, and UBoss must not be described as validated to any particular user count on the strength of them. What transfers between this machine and a cluster is the query plan. What does not transfer is the millisecond.

notMeasured.why: Entirely a property of the hardware and the connection pool. A number from here would mislead.
One API process, one database. Nothing here exercises a load balancer or a replica.
The gateway is in-process and the transport is not bound in this environment, so a fan-out measurement would be measuring an event emitter.
The queue selects its inline fallback without REDIS_URL, which is what the suite runs. Broker saturation needs the broker.
Connection leaks, cache drift and table bloat appear over time, and these runs are seconds.
